summary: Checked the 3 small fixes from iteration 5 and re-ran the backend tests. All pass. (1) SafetyActions: on /leads/{id} (owner) and /enquiry/{id} (buyer), tapping Block, then 'Tap to confirm', shows the thread-blocked-notice and hides thread-input with no reload. Unblock brings the composer back. (2) /admin/reports: a fast triple tap (Done, Done, Reject) sent only 1 POST and got 200. There was no 404 and no error toast. aria-disabled was true right after the first tap. The card was removed after the refetch. At 375px the 'Done'/'Reject' labels fit on one line (text height 26px, buttons 154x52). (3) auth.tsx: when /auth/me is aborted with a network error, the saved token is kept. An invalid token (401) is cleared. Backend: ran all 9 test files one by one with -n 0, 69/69 passed.
action_items: Minor/optional: in Thread.tsx, the local blockedMsg state (set when a send fails) is never cleared after an unblock. Clear it when the blocked prop changes to false.
Still open from earlier: marketplace.py is over 700 lines. test_iteration4_public_e2e.py leaves one test_del_* deletion request per run (cleaned up manually again).
critical_code_review_comments: SafetyActions keeps its own blocked state, which comes from initialBlocked. This works, but it could drift from server data if blocked_by_me changes elsewhere. You could derive it from the prop instead.
seed_data_creation: Used tests.ui_seed_iter6 (and unblocked via the API) to get the starting state, then ran the cleanup. Removed 1 leftover test_del_* deletion request. The 4 seeded test users are intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend per file with -n 0 and EXPO_BACKEND_URL set to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. UI seed: python -m tests.ui_seed_iter6 [cleanup]. The seed blocks the owner, so DELETE /enquiries/{eid}/block first to test the Block flow from the unblocked state.
